topic.title: Clarification on scoring edge cases and novelty-class definitions
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
Hi, thanks for hosting this competition. A few clarification questions so that local validation can match the official evaluation exactly:

  1. Empty entries in the prediction list. How does the evaluator treat an empty entry inside the semicolon-separated list, for example A;;B? Is B counted at rank 2 or rank 3? And does a trailing ; count as a guess, or could such a row be rejected?

  2. Reference implementation of the metric. Would you be able to share the evaluation code, or a reference implementation, including the exact RDKit 2026.03.3 tautomer canonicalisation settings used before taking the InChIKey first block? That would let everyone reproduce the scoring precisely.

  3. Novelty classes and COCONUT. The data page defines class 2 as structures in PubChem or COCONUT, and class 3 as structures not in PubChem at all. Can a class 3 molecule be present in COCONUT (in COCONUT but not in PubChem), or is class 3 absent from both databases?

Thank you!

comments.content:
Hi, and thank you for participating!

  1. Empty entries are discarded before ranks are assigned. A;;B is read as two guesses, so B is at rank 2, not rank 3. A trailing ; is not a guess and does not affect your score;

  2. The evaluation code is linked in the Overview section. It is here: https://www.kaggle.com/code/metric/casmi-mean-reciprocal-rank.

  3. Class 3 is absent from both PubChem and COCONUT.
